title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 38
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 38: Jeremiah let down into the mire, Ebedmelech's rescue, and the king's secret meeting with the prophet.

questions.text: According to the words Jeremiah spoke to all the people, what would happen to the one who goes out to the Chaldeans?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said that he who remains in this city will die by the sword, the famine and the pestilence, but he who goes out to the Chaldeans will live and escape with his life.

answers.text: He will live and escape with his life
He will die by the sword at once
He will be carried away to Egypt
He will be put in the court of the guard

questions.text: Why did the princes ask the king to put Jeremiah to death?
questions.explanation: The princes said Jeremiah should be put to death because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people.

answers.text: Because he had defected to the Chaldeans
Because he had burned a scroll of the king
Because he weakens the hands of the men of war
Because he had prophesied in the name of other gods

questions.text: What did Zedekiah the king answer the princes about Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah the king said, "Behold, he is in your hand; for the king can't do anything to oppose you."

answers.text: "Bring him to me in the third entry."
"He is in your hand; the king can't oppose you."
"Let no man lay a hand on the prophet."
"Send him away to the land of Benjamin."

questions.text: What was in the dungeon into which they let Jeremiah down with cords?
questions.explanation: They let Jeremiah down with cords into the dungeon of Malchijah the king's son, where there was no water but mire, and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

answers.text: It was full of water to the brim
It was heaped with stones
It held the stores of the city
No water, but mire, in which he sank

questions.text: Who was Ebedmelech, who heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon?
questions.explanation: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian was a eunuch who was in the king's house, and he heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon.

answers.text: An Ethiopian, a eunuch who was in the king's house
A captain of the guard at Benjamin's gate
A scribe who served among the princes
A priest of Yahweh's house in Jerusalem

questions.text: How many men did the king tell Ebedmelech to take with him?
questions.explanation: The king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian to take thirty men with him and take Jeremiah up out of the dungeon before he died.

answers.text: Ten men
Eighty men
Thirty men
Three men

questions.text: What did Ebedmelech let down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah?
questions.explanation: Ebedmelech took rags and worn-out garments from the house of the king and let them down by cords into the dungeon, telling Jeremiah to put them under his armpits under the cords.

answers.text: A ladder of wood
Rags and worn-out garments
Bread from the bakers' street
A basket of summer fruits

questions.text: What did Jeremiah say would happen if Zedekiah went out to the king of Babylon's princes?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said that if Zedekiah went out to the king of Babylon's princes, his soul would live, the city would not be burned with fire, and he would live along with his house.

answers.text: The Chaldeans would depart from the land
He would be made governor over the cities of Judah
He would be taken to Babylon in fetters
He would live with his house, and the city would not be burned

questions.text: What was Jeremiah to tell the princes if they asked what he had said to the king?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah was to tell them that he had presented his supplication before the king, that he would not cause him to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.

answers.text: That he had asked not to be sent back to Jonathan's house
That he had asked the king for bread and water
That the king had asked him about Pharaoh's army
That he had refused to speak with the king at all

questions.text: How long did Jeremiah stay in the court of the guard?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.

answers.text: Until the end of seven years
Until the day that Jerusalem was taken
Until Pharaoh's army came out of Egypt
Until the princes let him go home
